and stakeholder teams | Year-close scorecard and next-cycle recalibration, with the Conversation Management loop running as the always-on baseline. | The Invisible Thread works when proof is visible. | Needs: Key-Message Table (KMT) | Owned and executive reporting | Executive scorecard completed with paid, earned, shared, owned, service and reputation measures. |
